Class YouTubeAuthHelper

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.youtube.YouTubeAuthHelper
public class YouTubeAuthHelper extends Object
Pure Java Google OAuth 2.0 helper managing browser login, authorization code capture, and background access token refresh for YouTube Data API v3.

Operates with zero external OAuth dependencies by utilizing HttpServer for local callback interception, Desktop for system browser launch, and HttpClient for token exchanges.

  • Method Details

    • getValidAccessToken

      public static String getValidAccessToken(YouTubeCredentials credentials) throws IOException
      Obtains a valid, unexpired OAuth2 access token.

      If the cached token is expired or missing, it automatically refreshes the token using the stored refresh_token via Google's token endpoint.

      Parameters:
      credentials - The loaded YouTubeCredentials.
      Returns:
      A valid OAuth2 bearer access token.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the token request or refresh fails.

    • loginInteractive

      public static YouTubeCredentials loginInteractive(String clientId, String clientSecret, String playlistId) throws Exception
      Executes the interactive 1-click browser login flow.

      1. Launches a temporary local HTTP server on port 8888.
      2. Opens the user's default browser to Google's OAuth consent screen.
      3. Intercepts the authorization code from the redirect callback.
      4. Exchanges the code for a permanent refresh_token and access token.
      5. Saves credentials to ~/.anahata/asi/youtube/credentials.json.

      Parameters:
      clientId - The Google Cloud OAuth Client ID.
      clientSecret - The Google Cloud OAuth Client Secret.
      playlistId - The optional default playlist ID.
      Returns:
      The authenticated and saved YouTubeCredentials.
      Throws:
      Exception - If authorization or token exchange fails.
